clauses.quote: The service provider under this agreement is Juniper Reach Cloud.
This contract is identified as JRC-2026-05.
This service level agreement is effective on 2026-03-01.
We calculate availability for full calendar months using UTC.
The availability commitment applies to the Event Archive product and the Standard plan.
A claim must be submitted within 18 calendar days following month end.
The credit is calculated from the affected monthly service fees and credited to your next invoice.
